caption:
Five of the ten 2026 Ig Nobel Prizes, awarded 3 September in Zurich, the first ceremony outside the US. Biomechanics: Brindle, Talbot, West (Oxford), defining a kiss. Physics: Zhao Pan (Waterloo), the splash-free Nautilus urinal. Soil Science: Bender, van der Heijden (Agroscope, UZH), 1,000 buried underpants. Chemistry: Ramaswamy, Chavas, Coussens, cockroach milk protein. Olfaction: Croy, Sorokowska, Frackowiak, Hummel, how babies and teenagers smell to parents. Improbable Research; Nature news, 2026. Which one deserved it most?

slides.title: Five of the ten 2026 *Ig Nobel* Prizes
slides.sub: Awarded 3 September 2026 in Zurich, the first ceremony outside the US. All real research.

slides.title: What counts as a *kiss*?
slides.body: Matilda Brindle, Catherine Talbot and Stuart West, University of Oxford, defined it: non-agonistic oral-oral contact with some movement of the lips or mouthparts and no food transfer. Studied in ants, birds, polar bears and humans.

slides.title: The *splash-free* urinal
slides.body: A team led by Zhao Pan at the University of Waterloo designed the Nautilus, a urinal shaped to stop the splash.

slides.title: *Buried* underpants
slides.body: Franz Bender and Marcel van der Heijden (Agroscope, University of Zurich), Atlant Bieri and Pia Viviani buried 1,000 identical pairs in more than 25 countries and dug them up after two months. How far the cotton had broken down is a sign of healthy soil.

slides.title: Cockroach *"milk"*
slides.body: Subramanian Ramaswamy (Purdue), Leonard Chavas (DECTRIS Japan), Nathan Coussens (Frederick National Laboratory) and colleagues used X-ray crystallography on the milk protein of the cockroach Diploptera punctata. It carries about three times the energy of cow's milk protein.

slides.title: Babies smell *wonderful* to their parents. Teenagers do not.
slides.body: Ilona Croy and Thomas Hummel (University of Jena), Agnieszka Sorokowska and Tomasz Frackowiak (University of Wroclaw), on how parents perceive the smell of their own children at different ages.
